maria: Quick check-in: I pushed an updated packaging roadmap slice to the shared drive. We need to finalize GA gating for Private (VPC/on-prem) by Friday. Major unresolved customer asks: (1) operator-friendly BGP presets, (2) installer parity for air-gapped installs, (3) non-disruptive tenant-network upgrades and IP preservation. Thoughts?
vikram: Presets are necessary. I propose 3 supported topologies in presets.yaml (nat-relay, direct-bgp, routed-overlay) and a strict validation step during install to reject unsupported configs. Keeps field variance down.
leo: From field tickets: the top ask is predictable rollback. Customers want a documented, automated revert path that wont eject tenants. Can we guarantee a staged rollback that preserves tenant egress for >=99% flows?
sara: we cant promise the SLA yet, but we can ship a tested rollback procedure and label the SLO as "target behavior" for GA. Automation coverage: add checks for "egress preserved" and "control-plane election time".
kali: Security note: some customers ask for KMS/HSM bring-your-own. Thats a blocker for a few regulated customers. Recommend gating KMS as enterprise-only post-GA, but document the integration path.
maria: draft GA gating proposal: 1) BGP presets + relay fallback validated in CI; 2) airgap installer supports core runtime parity (telemetry optional in GA); 3) documented upgrade + rollback playbook with automation tests; 4) IP-preservation checklist for field cutovers. KMS/HSM deferred to post-GA with clear compatibility doc. OK to proceed?
vikram: Ill own presets.yaml PR. Will include validation schema and examples. ETA: Wed EOD.
leo: Ill spec the rollback automation cases and test vectors: 6 scenarios including peer-reject and partial-route-loss. ETA: 1.5 sprints.
sara: QA will add e2e automation for tenant egress and control-plane latency checks. Will need staging infra for partner-like network topologies.
kali: Security will draft the KMS deferral wording for public comms and the enterprise migration checklist.
